verdict.rationale: Elicit documents uploading your own PDFs in bulk to the Library with no stated limit, plus tagging and premium parsing for hard PDFs. You can also bring in a corpus from Zotero or RIS/BIB files and group it into Collections, from which you can launch reviews, extractions, chat and comparisons over those papers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the Research Agent itself queries an uploaded corpus (only Collection-launched reviews and extractions and chat with papers are documented); no independent or hands-on corroboration of research over user-uploaded PDFs.
